description: This file defines the OrleansJsonSerializerOptions class which encapsulates JSON serializer settings, and a configuration class ConfigureOrleansJsonSerializerOptions that implements post-configuration logic for Orleans serialization settings.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializerOptions
classes.description: Holds JSON serializer settings for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: ConfigureOrleansJsonSerializerOptions
classes.description: Implements post-configuration of OrleansJsonSerializerOptions using dependency injection.

methods.description: Applies additional configuration to OrleansJsonSerializerOptions after initial setup.
